title: Admin Product Experience Audit · UX Findings Report

audit_scope.persona: Operator · first contact · no training assumed

audit_method: static review of nav SSOT, page titles/subtitles, empty/error patterns, KPI labels, confirm flows · no code-correctness gate

grading_rubric.P0: 看不懂 — operator cannot understand what page/module/metric means or where they are
grading_rubric.P1: 容易误操作 — naming/IA/ missing guardrails lead to wrong module or risky action
grading_rubric.P2: 效率低 — task completable but slow, inconsistent patterns, missing shortcuts

goal: Admin usable for daily ops without training before real-user UAT
staging_policy: no staging changes · no token fixes · no new features during soak
post_audit_sequence: Admin PEA spot-check on /admin/* sample paths
33/33 GO → Token Debt Sprint → next testnet release

findings.title: Growth Center 与 Trust Growth 同名异义，运营无法区分
findings.expected: Sidebar/标题明确区分 Referral/Early Bird 增长台 vs Banner A/B 信任增长台
findings.actual: Growth 组 vs Governance 组 trust-growth 均含 Growth/增长；Home audit_finance 卡片再引入第三入口
findings.operator_impact: 首次运营不知道打开哪个控制台配置邀请码或 Banner

findings.title: Operations「Guide onboarding」与 Official「Official Guides」导航无法区分
findings.expected: Nav 消歧：入驻审核 vs 官方内容发布
findings.actual: Operations admin_guides_title=Guide onboarding；Official admin_shell_nav_official_guides=Official Guides
findings.operator_impact: 发布官方攻略时可能进入向导 KYB 台账

findings.title: Community 首项 Nav「Community governance」实际指向举报队列
findings.expected: Nav 标签与页面 H1「Community reports/举报工单」一致
findings.actual: admin_shell_nav_community_hub=Community governance；无 /admin/community hub；H1=Community reports
findings.operator_impact: 运营找「治理台」却进入工单列表，或找「举报」对不上 Nav

findings.title: P1 四平面深页 breadcrumb 仅显示 Workspace，丢失域上下文
findings.expected: Breadcrumb 显示 Content / Official Ops / Growth 分组 + 叶子页
findings.actual: adminShellContextForPath 缺少 content/official_ops/growth PREFIX_GROUPS；返回 null
findings.operator_impact: 深页运营不知道自己在哪个平面，无法回溯 Hub

findings.title: 页面副标题大量 Sprint/模块代号，运营看不懂业务含义
findings.expected: 副标题描述业务目的与消费者影响，无工程 ticket
findings.actual: Content/Official/Growth 页 subtitle 含 M1–M10、G-S7、O-S4、C-S1 等代号
findings.operator_impact: 首次接触无法从标题理解页面职责

findings.title: 两套 Analytics 指标来源不同但命名相近，指标定义未自解释
findings.expected: 页级说明 KPI 口径、时间窗、数据源
findings.actual: Growth analytics=server aggregates；Conversion analytics=localStorage PES；Registrations 一个有(30d)一个无
findings.operator_impact: 运营对比两页数字会得出错误结论

findings.title: Geo validation 页展示原始 HOLD/GO、PASS/FAIL、环境变量名
findings.expected: 运营可读的状态与修复建议
findings.actual: UI 渲染技术枚举与 env 名
findings.operator_impact: 非工程运营无法理解验证结果

findings.title: Penalties/Appeals breadcrumb 引用缺失 i18n key，叶子标题不可读
findings.expected: Breadcrumb 显示与 Sidebar 一致的 Penalties/Appeals
findings.actual: adminShellContextForPath 用 admin_community_penalties_title/admin_community_appeals_title，locale 不存在
findings.operator_impact: 面包屑显示 raw key 或空白，位置感丢失

findings.title: Workspace Home 无 Content/Official/Growth 入口，四平面仅 Sidebar 可见
findings.expected: 首次登录 Home 可发现 CMS/Official/Growth 日常任务入口
findings.actual: ADMIN_HOME_CARDS 无 P1 平面卡片；Command palette 亦不含；Home section 仍标 Community & content
findings.operator_impact: 无培训时运营不知道 CMS/Growth 在哪开始

findings.title: Governance execution UAT 页为脚本/证据路径，非日常运营语言
findings.expected: 治理 UAT 页有运营可读摘要或链到 runbook
findings.actual: Sepolia script sequence + evidence pack 目录名
findings.operator_impact: Ops 误入后无法理解要做什么

findings.title: CMS 发布/Import 无 L5 确认对话框，与 Community 处置不一致
findings.expected: Publish/import 前有后果说明与二次确认
findings.actual: countries/POI/publish-queue/import 一键 Publish；Community moderation 有 admin_l5_confirm
findings.operator_impact: 易误触 live catalog 变更

findings.title: Official 发布与冷启动 Deploy/Rollback 无确认与风险 Banner
findings.expected: Deploy/rollback 前确认 consumer 影响范围
findings.actual: Publish directly / deploy / rollback 即时执行；subtitle 提 impact 但无 inline guard
findings.operator_impact: 易误部署冷启动或发布错误官方内容

findings.title: Growth anti-fraud freeze/unfreeze 无确认
findings.expected: 冻结/解冻邀请或账户前二次确认
findings.actual: Underlined link 即时执行
findings.operator_impact: 误冻结增长用户或 referral

findings.title: Conversion analytics「Clear local data」无确认对话框
findings.expected: destructive clear 需确认
findings.actual: ConversionFunnelDashboard 直接清除 localStorage
findings.operator_impact: 误删本地漏斗样本

findings.title: Content Hub 链接网格遗漏 Country market（Sidebar 有）
findings.expected: Hub 覆盖 Sidebar 全部 Content 模块
findings.actual: adminShellContentNavLinks 含 country-market；AdminContentHubLinks 未含
findings.operator_impact: 从 Hub 进入后找不到国别市场模块，改从 Sidebar 摸索

findings.title: Official Hub 副标题/正文锁死在 O-S4 冷启动，掩盖 M7–M9 模块
findings.expected: Hub 概述账号/攻略/模板/冷启动四模块
findings.actual: Hub 仅用 admin_official_hub_subtitle_os4；os1–os3 locale 未用
findings.operator_impact: 运营以为 Official Ops=仅冷启动

findings.title: Top bar 与 Sidebar 权限 SSOT 不一致，链接可见性可能不同
findings.expected: Top bar 与 Sidebar 同一 permission 规则
findings.actual: shellNav() 用 adminHomeCardRequiredPermission 默认 admin.read；Sidebar 用 CONTENT_READ 等
findings.operator_impact: Top bar 出现无法使用的链接或 Sidebar 有而 Top bar 无

findings.title: Sidebar 组可见但子链按 capability 隐藏，无「权限不足」解释
findings.expected: 空组或折叠时说明所需 console role/perm
findings.actual: Ops 见 Finance/Community 组但 finance/disputes/penalties 链可能缺失
findings.operator_impact: 运营以为功能未上线而非权限问题

findings.title: Growth analytics 展示 raw growth_fraud_status 枚举
findings.expected: 运营可读欺诈状态标签
findings.actual: Fraud breakdown 渲染 API 原始 status 字符串
findings.operator_impact: 误判风险等级或无法向业务解释

findings.title: Conversion analytics 漏斗矩阵显示 raw stage ID
findings.expected: 阶段名翻译为运营语言
findings.actual: fromStageId/toStageId 直接展示
findings.operator_impact: 无法解读 drop-off 发生在哪一步

findings.title: 入驻三队列 Sidebar/Home/Operator guide 各用不同名称
findings.expected: 同一队列在 Nav、Home card、Guide 步骤同名
findings.actual: Provider queue vs Merchant onboarding queue vs admin_operator_flow_provider 等 3–4 套
findings.operator_impact: 重复搜索同一队列

findings.title: Operator guide 仅 6 步 inbox 流，未覆盖 CMS/Official/Growth 日常任务
findings.expected: 首次运营 runbook 覆盖四平面主路径
findings.actual: inbox→provider→steward→approvals→reports→permissions；无 content/official/growth
findings.operator_impact: 按 guide 完成仍不会 CMS 发布或 Growth 配置

findings.title: 多数 CMS 列表页空数据时仅空白表格，无引导空态
findings.expected: 空态说明如何创建首条记录 + 链到 publish-queue
findings.actual: countries/cities/pois 等无 empty prop；与 Community warm empty 对比
findings.operator_impact: 新环境运营以为页面故障

findings.title: Official 列表统一 ops_plane_empty「Nothing here yet.» 无下一步
findings.expected: 空态链到创建账号/攻略/模板或 cold-start deploy 文档
findings.actual: Generic empty；无 nextLinks
findings.operator_impact: 空库时不知先做什么

findings.title: Finance summary 部分 KPI 以 raw JSON 块展示
findings.expected: 卡片化可读指标 + 口径 footnote
findings.actual: AdminFinanceSummaryGridSection 含 status count JSON tiles
findings.operator_impact: 财务/运营无法快速读数

findings.title: Sidebar「Official Ops」vs Hub H1「Official Operations」
findings.expected: Nav 与 H1 一致
findings.actual: admin_shell_nav_official_hub vs admin_official_hub_title
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 同一模块两种英文

findings.title: Sidebar 组「Content」vs Hub「Content Center」
findings.expected: 组名与 Hub 标题一致
findings.actual: admin_shell_nav_group_content vs admin_content_hub_title
findings.operator_impact: 轻度命名漂移

findings.title: Community 子项 Nav 缩写与 Page H1 长度不一致
findings.expected: Nav 可短但 tooltip/aria 与 H1 对齐
findings.actual: Mod cases vs Community moderation cases 等
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 搜索时匹配困难

findings.title: Finance suite / Finance · hub / reconciliation suite 三名混用
findings.expected: Finance 组内链接命名层级一致
findings.actual: admin_shell_nav_finance_suite vs finance_reconciliation vs admin_fin_suite_title
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 多点击试错

findings.surface: Ops plane vs L5 list loading
findings.title: Content/Growth 用 skeleton；Community/Operations 用文本 loading
findings.expected: Admin 内 loading 模式统一
findings.actual: OpsPlaneFetchStates skeleton vs AdminListLoadingStatus text
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 感知性能与专业度不一致

findings.title: Home 三层 KPI（inbox / ops snapshot / system overview）口径未互链
findings.expected: Footnote 说明各层数据源与 cap
findings.actual: 三层并存；honesty footnote 分散
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 读数需交叉验证

findings.title: Growth Hub subtitle 仍引用 G-S7/S1 且 locale body 有过时 copy
findings.expected: Hub intro 描述当前已 ship 模块
findings.actual: admin_growth_hub_subtitle_s1；admin_growth_hub_body_s1 过时
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 信任度下降

findings.title: Onboarding Sidebar 三队列在前、Hub 居中，与 mental model 相反
findings.expected: Hub 置顶或分组「Queues / Tools」
findings.actual: adminShellOnboardingNavLinks 顺序：queues→hub→entitlements→…
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 首次需滚动找 Hub

findings.title: Operator guide 不在 Sidebar workspace 组，仅 Home/maintainer fold
findings.expected: Workspace 组固定「Operator guide / 运营手册」
findings.actual: Sidebar workspace 仅 /admin + /admin/inbox
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 手册难找

findings.title: Observability overview 空态为 plain text 无 retry 组件
findings.expected: 与 OpsPlane 一致 empty + retry
findings.actual: No overview payload returned plain
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 空态体验弱于其他页

findings.title: KOL center 复用 analytics window label key，控件语义漂移
findings.expected: KOL 专属时间窗/指标标签
findings.actual: admin_growth_analytics_window_label 用于非 analytics 控件
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 误解时间窗含义

findings.title: Operations 列表空态缺少 Community 级 hintKey/nextLinks
findings.expected: Orders/Disputes empty 链到 inbox 或 filter 说明
findings.actual: AdminListPageEmptyState 无 nextLinks（对比 community reports）
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 空队列时不知下一步

findings.title: Users 在 Operations 与 Onboarding Hub 意图标签不同
findings.expected: 同一路由单一产品名 + 场景副标题
findings.actual: admin_users_title vs admin_onboarding_hub_users Per-user entitlements
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 同一页两种入口叙事

findings.title: Governance 组含 cross-check/drift/trust-growth，仅 execution-uat 在 governance/ 目录
findings.expected: Nav 分组与 URL 路径或文档一致
findings.actual: Folder structure ≠ sidebar grouping
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 深链接/bookmark 混乱

findings.title: Ops 角色 Home primary CTA 仅 provider/steward/reports，缺 Content/Growth
findings.expected: Home CTA 与 Sidebar 四平面 visibility 对齐
findings.actual: adminHomePrimaryCtaByRole Ops 不含 content/official/growth
findings.operator_impact: 轻度 — 日常 CMS/Growth 任务多一步
